posts.zh:
dsh-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0a450e2666f0b87ee81d.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0a450e2666f0b87ee81d.html
